carried.pc_raw: Brigus, Seedborn, King of the Great Basin, Beacon. Wounds: None. Status: exhausted after the Feral God merge, victorious, directing reconstruction and has chosen development of an elite rapid-response force to protect settlements, caravans, and wounded Engines. Five Engines: Gold Sledge, black-and-gold gorilla Bulwark, Bond 4/5, exhausted and battered, Titanium-Cestus (Diamond-Claw melted Turn 126), neural Sentient Seat (not a saddle-harness); Skytalon, ADULT Shadow-Owl, Bond 5/5, exhausted and battered, sleek radar-absorbent silent chassis, echolocation, mono-molecular feather-blades, adult Molt Turn 129, no longer juvenile or hard-light winged; Razor-Back, Bond 3/5, field-patched, previously exhausted and battered following Turn 128 Pack Merge; Goliath Dreadnought, Bond 5/5, field-patched, pre-war machine, left mortar pod destroyed Turn 112; Surveyor-Strider, Bond 5/5, exhausted and battered, observation and fire-control platform. Pack: Vance, Tull, Queen Kaelen, Nest-Keeper. Vance, Tull, and Kaelen in Great Basin; Nest-Keeper in Chalk Canyons. Faction: Ironwild Legion, 600 strong, including absorbed Dust-Baron mercenaries. Great Basin fortified. Elite rapid-response force selected as the development objective; doctrine drafted, personnel not yet selected, equipment not yet manufactured. All Engine Bonds unchanged.
